systems.system: Data Center e Cloud Nacional do Governo de Angola

AGO.note: Notice announces the inauguration of 28 April 2026; services to private entities are only foreseen.

facts.fact: MINTTICS announced on 27 April 2026 the official inauguration of the National Government Data Center and Cloud at Camama, Luanda, as part of a government strategy to reinforce digital sovereignty and reduce dependence on external infrastructure.
facts.system: Data Center e Cloud Nacional do Governo de Angola

AGO.note: The state-owned centre is described as designed for government data; hire to private users is foreseen and state hosting in service is not yet stated.
